director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek poore ke barabar hisse karke bhinn banayenge. Toh shuru karte hain?

Chalo, main batati hoon. Ghar mein ek roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hai. Har hisse ka ek naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rang wala ek hissa poori roti ka 1/4 hai. Poore ke barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
1/4 mein neeche wala 4 batata hai ki roti kitne barabar hisson mein bati. Ab bagal wali roti ke hisse gino. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon. Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?

director.text: ek-aathvaan

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Do pattiyan dekho, dono ke 3 hisse. A ke teeno hisse barabar hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse chhote-bade hain, toh unhe gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Pehle socho, yahi patti teen barabar hisson mein kaatte toh har hissa kitna lamba hota. Phir dekho kaunsa hissa utna lamba hai. 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hisson wali 15 cm ki patti mein, kaunsa hissa 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: 5 centimetre wala

Bilkul sahi. Suno, patti ke teen barabar hisse 5-5 cm ke hote. Ab do ribbon lo: P 20 cm ki, Q 12 cm ki. P ka 1/2 10 cm hai, aur Q ka 1/2 6 cm. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek: P ka 1/4 5 cm, Q ka sirf 3 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ab dekhna hai ki ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai. Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan ganna ek scale par hai, 0 se 30 cm tak, aur 6 cm par ek nishaan: ek hissa itna lamba hai. 30 cm ke ganne mein 6 cm ke kitne hisse hain, yeh jaanne ke liye kaunsa hisaab karoge?
pata nahi
Har hissa 6 cm ka hai aur poora ganna 30 cm. Socho, 6 cm ke hisse ek ke baad ek rakhte jao toh 30 cm tak kitne aayenge, aur yeh kis hisaab se niklega. Ab tum batao.
haan
Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

Hisson ki ginti ke liye 30 ko 6 se bhaag denge, kyunki dekhna hai ki 30 cm mein 6 cm kitni baar aata hai. Dhyaan rakhna, fractional unit ke neeche hisse ki lambai 6 nahi aati; neeche woh ginti aati hai ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1/6 sahi nahi hai. Pehle 30 cm mein 6 cm ke hisse gino. Phir yaad karo, roti ke ek hisse ka naam uske barabar hisse gin kar kaise diya tha. 30 cm ke ganne ka 6 cm wala ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: 1 by 5

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai, kyunki 30 ÷ 6 = 5 barabar hisse bane, aur neeche hisson ki ginti aati hai, hisse ki lambai nahi. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

Bilkul sahi. Suno, 24 cm ka 1/3 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm hai, aur 8 cm ka hissa sirf 1 hai. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Dono ribbon ka hissa alag-alag nikalo, phir dono lambaiyan milao. 36 cm ka 1/3, 24 cm ke 1/2 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: paanch cm

Bilkul sahi, kyunki Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: do hisse

Haan, bilkul theek. Suno, har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6. Ab teen chocolate ki pattiyan lo, teeno ek hi size ki. Pehli 3 doston mein barabar bati, doosri 5 mein, teesri 10 mein. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. In pattiyon ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?
director.card: In pattiyon ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

director.text: 1/3 sahi nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Do ek jaisi roti: ek 2 logon mein bati, doosri 8 mein. 8 bada number hai, phir bhi 8 logon wala hissa chhota, kyunki roti wahi hai. Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

director.text: Nahi, 1/4 theek nahi. Ek jitni dor ke jitne zyada barabar hisse, har hissa utna chhota. Socho, kis dor ke hisse sabse zyada hain. 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati teen ek jitni dor mein se kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

director.text: 1/4 se baat nahi bani. 4 sabse chhota number hai, par 4 hisson wali dor par kainchi sabse kam baar chali, toh uske hisse sabse lambe hain, chhote nahi. Jo socha hai, woh bol do.
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

director.text: 9 hisson wali dor

Haan, sahi hai: teeno dor ek jitni, par 9 wali sabse zyada hisson mein kati, toh uska hissa 1/9 sabse chhota. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5: inmein sabse chhota hissa kaun hai?
director.card: In pattiyon ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: one tenth

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala, toh 1/10 sabse chhota. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek patti barabar baantni hai. Hissa 1/3 se chhota par 1/6 se bada chahiye, aur dost 2, 4 ya 7 ho sakte hain. Dekhna hai kitne dost theek rahenge. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?
